input: My name is Elena Maric, my application reference is CS-4827, and I paid 75 euros for the permit last Tuesday. Where should I send the receipt?
expected_answer: Please send the receipt to the email address provided in your application confirmation. If you need further assistance, you can also contact the Permits Office.
expected_urgency_rationale: Asks where to send a receipt which is a routine request. No urgency, deadline or emergency.

input: The appointment is booked for tomorrow at 10:30, and the reference number is LT-2048. Which details should I include in the request?
expected_answer: For additional information regarding your appointment, contact the relevant department or office handling your appointment. They will provide you with the necessary details to include in your request.
expected_urgency_rationale: Request refers to a booked appointment, which is a time-sensitive inquiry. No urgency or emergency.

input: I am Marco Bianchi. I sent the form on 3 April, but I cannot find the confirmation number. Could you check whether the form was received?
expected_answer: Our team will check our records for the form you sent on 3 April. We will confirm whether it was received and provide you with the confirmation number if available.
expected_urgency_rationale: Asks to check whether a form was received, which is a routine request. No urgency, deadline or emergency.

input: The road has swallowed the drain cover outside the school again, and children walk past it every morning

input: Bonjour, my name is Claire Dubois. Mon numéro de dossier est FR-7719 and the amount paid was 42,50 euros. Pouvez-vous confirmer que ces informations sont bien enregistrées?
expected_answer: Bonjour, on va contrôler les informations que vous avez fournies. Nous vous confirmerons si elles sont bien enregistrées dans notre système.
expected_urgency_rationale: Asks to confirm information, which is a routine request. No urgency, deadline or emergency.

input: My name is Elisa Pitzalis. I paid 100 euros for the speeding ticket on 15 March, and my reference number is SP-3345. Also, the streetlight outside my house has been flickering for a week. Can you confirm the payment and also report the streetlight issue?
expected_answer: Regarding the streetlight issue, contact the local emergencies services. As for the payment for the speeding ticket, please get in touch with the relevant department.
expected_urgency_rationale: The request combines a routine inquiry about a payment with an urgent safety concern regarding a flickering streetlight, which requires immediate attention.

input: I am furious about the delay in processing my application. I submitted it two weeks ago and have not received any updates. Check the status of my application immediately.
expected_answer: We understand your frustration regarding the delay in processing your application. Please contact the relevant department for assistance with checking the status of your application.

input: Hello, my name is Marco Bianchi. I am contacting you about a form that I submitted on 3 April. I remember completing it that day because I was dealing with a few other administrative tasks at the same time and wanted to get everything finished before the end of the week. As far as I know, the form was submitted correctly. I normally save confirmation emails and reference numbers in a separate folder, but I have checked my inbox, spam folder, and saved messages and cannot find the confirmation number anywhere. I may have accidentally deleted it, or perhaps I never received the confirmation email. Could you please check whether my form was successfully received and, if possible, provide the confirmation number?
expected_answer: Our team will check our records for the form you sent on 3 April. We will confirm whether it was received and provide you with the confirmation number if available.
expected_urgency_rationale: Asks to check whether a form was received, which is a routine request. No urgency, deadline or emergency.
